description: Caerira wears a floor-length opaque olive-green court gown with a low square neckline and a naturally fitted structured bodice. Broad gold-and-brown woven knotwork borders frame the neckline, shoulder straps, waist, center opening and hem. Two circular gold-toned brooches fasten the straps at the upper chest. The overdress opens over an opaque pale linen underskirt, with the opening remaining below the knee. Elbow-length green outer sleeves have pale linen bands, and a matching bordered shoulder wrap rests around the arms and hangs alongside the skirt. A woven decorated belt has a small round center ornament and a narrow hanging front strip. One brown leather shoe projects beneath the hem. There is no headgear, armor or weapon; substantial opaque fabric covers bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis.
